summary.title: SUMMARY
summary.text: MSc Finance graduate with strong quantitative skills and corporate and investment banking experience. Former expatriate in Asia with exposure to CEE markets and fluent Polish. Avid kitesurfer.

bullets: Analysed the financing for a client’s EUR 9.9bn acquisition, modeling pro forma financials and synergies.
Conducted in-depth credit corporate analysis for 7+ large-cap corporates, researching financials and reports.
Assessed counterparty credit risk on complex derivatives including interest rate swaps and equity swaps.
Coordinated a risk management committee for 10 Managing Directors across APAC, US and EMEA.
Built Power BI dashboards consolidating trade surveillance alerts and improving early-warning detection.
Resolved limit breaches and exceptions with Trading, Compliance and Central Risk.
Directed negotiations and acquisitions of 5 cars closing transactions exceeding €200k in Germany.
Built an engaged social media community of 1,600+ followers through strategic content development and consistent engagement, generating 70k+ views @ghostc.eu.
Built Python scripts to parse trading system logs, detecting model errors and escalating them to traders.
Supported daily P&L computation for a market-making desk, reconciling inventory-based positions.
Participated in the 2023 J.P. Morgan Corporate Challenge strengthening collaboration and team integration.
Assisted in the EUR 50mn acquisition of Guérin Joilleries supporting executive meeting and documentation.
Assigned commission revenues to partners streamlining EUR 800k/month of sales.
Researched competitors’ prices to benchmark Mauboussin's positioning in luxury sector.
Conducted credit and sector research on corporate clients to support bankers in pitch preparation.
Built and maintained Excel tracking tools consolidating the team’s client credit portfolio and live deal pipeline.
Monitored market news and credit events to flag early warning signals on portfolio clients.
